ex.en: The argument rests on the premise that prices will keep rising.
ex.zh: 这一论点以价格将持续上涨为前提。

words.note: 常用 on the premise that；复数 premises 指房屋场地。

ex.en: The children cheered as the circus clowns tumbled into the ring.
ex.zh: 马戏团小丑翻着跟头进场，孩子们欢呼起来。

words.note: 源自拉丁语「圆圈」；口语 a circus 可指乱哄哄的场面。

ex.en: The new tax on plastic bags proved highly controversial among shoppers.
ex.zh: 新的塑料袋税在购物者中引起了极大争议。

words.note: 名词是 controversy，重音在第三音节 -ver-。

ex.en: Few runners attain such speed without years of hard training.
ex.zh: 没有多年刻苦训练，很少有跑者能达到这样的速度。

words.note: 强调经努力达到目标，比 reach 正式；名词 attainment。

ex.en: The new law would deprive many families of their homes.
ex.zh: 这项新法律将剥夺许多家庭的住房。

words.note: 必须与 of 连用：deprive sb of sth，不可省略 of。

ex.en: The landlord asked the tenant to move out by the end of June.
ex.zh: 房东要求房客在六月底前搬走。

words.note: 与 landlord（房东）相对；tenant farmer 指佃农。

ex.en: The heavy rain caused floods and the resultant damage was enormous.
ex.zh: 大雨引发洪水，由此造成的损失巨大。

words.note: 形容词，表「因而产生的」，多用于正式或学术文体。

ex.en: Farmers are using fewer chemicals to control pests in the fields.
ex.zh: 农民正在减少使用化学品来控制田里的害虫。

words.note: 指害虫或讨厌的人；pesticide 指杀虫剂，常一起出现。

ex.en: She pedalled slowly up the hill, breathing hard in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她慢慢地蹬车上坡，在冷空气中喘着粗气。

words.note: 作动词时英式双写 l（pedalled），美式 pedaled。

ex.en: Waves battered the small boat for hours before it reached the shore.
ex.zh: 海浪拍打了小船几个小时，它才靠岸。

words.note: 指反复猛击；battered 可形容「破旧不堪的」。

ex.en: The old town was listed as a world heritage site last year.
ex.zh: 这座古镇去年被列为世界遗产地。

words.note: 不可数，指世代相传的文化传统；常与 cultural 连用。

ex.en: The Supreme Court agreed to hear the case again next month.
ex.zh: 最高法院同意下个月再次审理此案。

words.note: 表「最高的」，无比较级；the Supreme Court 最高法院。

ex.en: The robbers took two customers hostage and demanded a car.
ex.zh: 劫匪劫持了两名顾客作人质，索要一辆车。

words.note: take sb hostage 人质前不加冠词；release a hostage。

ex.en: Safety must take priority over speed when the roads are icy.
ex.zh: 路面结冰时，安全必须优先于速度。

words.note: 常用 give priority to、take priority over，注意介词。

ex.en: The garden slopes gently down to the river behind the house.
ex.zh: 花园缓缓下斜，一直延伸到屋后的河边。

words.note: 可作名词「斜坡」与动词「倾斜」；steep slope 高频。

ex.en: The fishing boats rested in a quiet inlet away from the wind.
ex.zh: 渔船停泊在一个避风的安静小湾里。

words.note: 与 outlet 相对：inlet 进口、小湾，outlet 出口、销路。

ex.en: The water from the old pipe had a strange metallic taste.
ex.zh: 旧水管里的水有一股奇怪的金属味。

words.note: metal 是名词「金属」，metallic 形容金属般的。

ex.en: A free shuttle bus runs between the hotel and the airport.
ex.zh: 酒店和机场之间有免费穿梭巴士。

words.note: 作动词表「穿梭往返」；shuttle bus 最常见。

ex.en: Lizards can regenerate their tails after they are attacked.
ex.zh: 蜥蜴遭袭击后能再生尾巴。

words.note: re-（再）+ generate（生成）→ 再生；名词 regeneration。

ex.en: The school allocated more money to sports facilities this year.
ex.zh: 学校今年拨出更多资金用于体育设施。

words.note: allocate sth to sb/sth 把…分配给；名词 allocation。

ex.en: The course helps students discover their latent talent for design.
ex.zh: 这门课帮助学生发现自己在设计方面的潜在才能。

words.note: 指存在但未显现的，常与 demand、talent 搭配。

ex.en: You look terrific in that blue jacket, she said with a smile.
ex.zh: “你穿那件蓝色夹克真好看，”她笑着说。

words.note: 口语多表「极好的」，而非「可怕的」；与 terrible 区分。

ex.en: From a practical standpoint, the plan is too costly to carry out.
ex.zh: 从实际角度看，这个计划成本太高，难以实施。

words.note: 常与 from 连用，相当于 point of view，但更书面。

ex.en: Our primary concern is the safety of the children on the bus.
ex.zh: 我们首要关心的是车上孩子们的安全。

words.note: 指首要的、初级的；副词 primarily 表「主要地」。

ex.en: Police seized thousands of pirated films from the market stall.
ex.zh: 警方从市场摊位上查获了数千张盗版影片。

words.note: 作动词表盗印；pirated software 指盗版软件。

ex.en: He was too stubborn to admit that his plan had failed.
ex.zh: 他太固执，不肯承认自己的计划失败了。

words.note: 既指人固执，也指问题难解决，如 a stubborn cough。

ex.en: The committee spent months trying to formulate a policy on data privacy.
ex.zh: 委员会花了几个月试图制定数据隐私政策。

words.note: 指系统地提出、制定，多接 policy、plan、theory。

ex.en: Older machines consume far more electricity than modern ones.
ex.zh: 旧机器比现代机器耗电多得多。

words.note: consumer 消费者，consumption 消耗量，注意词形。

ex.en: The golden dome of the cathedral shines in the morning sun.
ex.zh: 大教堂的金色穹顶在晨光中闪闪发亮。

words.note: 指圆屋顶，也比喻半球形结构，如 the dome of the sky。

ex.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old furniture in the room.
ex.zh: 房间里旧家具上覆盖着厚厚一层灰。

words.note: 常与 of 连用表「一层…」；动词 layer 表分层堆放。
